annual.label: Average yearly repair cost for Lexus vehicles overall (RepairPal; no TX-specific figure yet)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 12 months (check owner's manual)
maint.note: Uses low-viscosity full synthetic. Lexus includes complimentary scheduled maintenance for the first 2 years/20,000 miles on new models.

maint.every: About every 40,000-70,000 miles; hybrids often last longer thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: RepairPal estimates about $410-450 for a front pad replacement alone.
Hybrid and plug-in models also have a high-voltage battery that is not a routine service item.
RepairPal estimates about $340-430 for the TX 350. The V6 in the TX 550h+ takes more labor.

maint.every: First at about 100,000 miles, then every 50,000 miles with Toyota Super Long Life coolant
maint.note: Hybrids have a separate inverter cooling loop with its own interval.
